translations.web: You shall make on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.
translations.bsb: For the breastpiece, make braided chains like cords of pure gold.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends of wreathen work of pure gold.
translations.asv: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains like cords, of wreathen work of pure gold.
